objective: Test whether UberBond can synthesize a useful representation primitive absent from the base representation vocabulary and whether that frozen primitive transfers to distinct task families.
baseRepresentationVocabulary: depth-2 AND/OR/XOR composition of base literals

numericExpressionFamily: FLOOR_DIV(X_TIMES_(X_PLUS_C),K) for integer C in [-3,3] and K in [2,8]
synthesisMetaGrammar.selection: Discovery train accuracy, then discovery validation accuracy, then shorter description length, then lexical expression ID.
synthesisMetaGrammar.restriction: The hidden target expression name and formula are not supplied to the synthesis selector as a candidate label. The selector receives only the fixed generic meta-grammar above.

negativeControl.hiddenRule: deterministic hash-derived label outside the declared shallow synthesis/transfer families

split.law: The synthesized primitive is frozen before transfer-task outcomes are scored. Held-out partitions never participate in primitive selection.

falsifier: Discovery primitive fails either discovery threshold.
Fewer than two transfer tasks pass both transfer thresholds.
Negative control is spuriously solved above 0.85.
Search candidate count or description-length burden is omitted.
promotionBoundary: A pass establishes only a deterministic synthetic primitive-synthesis-and-transfer mechanism. It does not prove open-ended ontology invention, new mathematics, scientific discovery, or general intelligence.
